column1: # Numbers formatted by ECMA-402's Intl.NumberFormat in Node 24.9.0 (ICU 77.1, CLDR 47.0),
# locale "en", currency USD, for every combination of rounding priority, significant and
# fraction digit bounds, notation, style and rounding mode in two grids: twelve values near
# the carry boundaries of compact magnitudes, and ten values with signs, small values,
# minimum bounds, the percent style and half-even rounding. An empty bound is not given.
# Columns: value, notation, style, maximum significant digits, minimum significant digits,
# maximum fraction digits, minimum fraction digits, rounding priority, rounding mode, result.
